It submits complete certificates at 148 counts from 5 to 308: the 147 rational certificates of the v2 release, of which the algebraic supplement replaces 58 with algebraic certificates and N146 with a tighter rational one, and the exact N153/N302 supplement replaces two with algebraic certificates; and a tighter rational N261 certificate, outside the 147.

The algebraic supplement (release data/pingyou-algebraic-refinements-2026-10-13-v1) states 60 exact certificates: 48 over Q(sqrt(2)), eight other quadratic, quartic or cap constructions (N18, N53, N54, N107, N151, N178, N234, N299), the degree-five N70 and N207, and rational N146 and N261, each strictly below its named predecessor; N53's enclosing side lies in Q(sqrt(7)) but its coordinates use a degree-eight field, and N151 a biquadratic one. COVERAGE-147.json accounts for the 147 v2 counts: 59 improved, 82 retained pending algebraic reconstruction, N50 and N171 already exact rational, N153 and N302 already exact algebraic, N204 and N264 older radical constructions dominated.

The exact supplement (release data/pingyou-exact-153-302-2026-10-13-v1) states s(153) <= 12 + (1+3t^2)/(1+2t-t^2) with t the root in (7/20, 9/25) of t^7-9t^6+3t^5-t^4-t^3+t^2-3t+1, and s(302) <= 33/2 + (7/2)t + t^2 with t the root in (7/20, 9/25) of 2t^3-3t^2-2t+1.

The submission states that the padding reductions and attainments are not 148 new nominal constructions, new algebraic optima or optimality proofs, that original construction authors keep their credit, and that its own checkers, a standard-library SAT and polygon checker and this repository's two verifiers at e96e9ea, accepted every final certificate.
